added: Switch between your lists from the editor's toolbar, without leaving the one you're in.
Recent changes name what happened, "Removed Nunatak quilt liner", instead of "Edited 1 item".
changed: The toolbar now says when your list was last edited, and only mentions syncing when there's something to say.
The gear vault's sign-in prompt is one line now, and reads the same on the vault page and beside a list.
A folder's controls now stay visible instead of appearing on hover.
On a shared list, the export formats group under one "Export" item, matching the editor.
On a shared list, "Copy this list" is "Duplicate this list", the editor's name for it.
On a shared list, signing in is an icon in the top bar like the rest of it, and the ⋯ menu sits at the end.
The trail link panel asks for a "URL".
The footer no longer links to the page you're already on.
Signing in opens over the page you're on, so you never lose your list.
The sign-in dialog says "Sign in" rather than "Your account" when you don't have one yet.
Deleting your account now asks once, with a checkbox for your lists, instead of two questions in a row.
The account's fields and buttons are contained, and Delete account is red.
fixed: The gear vault no longer offers to save a list's gear while you're signed out.
On a phone, an item's gear type now sits tight under its row instead of floating below it.
The footer no longer offers a gear vault link when you're signed out.
Signing in now returns you to the list you were on, instead of leaving you on the account page.
A shared list no longer prints the top bar's buttons.
